titulo: Put their time zone in the invite too
caption:
Put their time zone in the invite too

Cella sends a meeting time as 3 PM ET, then adds the other person's time right under it: 12 PM PT.

For whoever writes the time in their time zone too.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a pink wall. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a royal blue one stands on the right looking away. Between them on the floor, a plain white block reads 3 pm et. A second block pops up right above it and reads 12 pm pt. The royal blue figure turns, its eyes go wide and then close in a smile and it pulses. Both lean in slightly toward each other and a star appears. The text stays: 1 meeting, 2 time zones. The last card: for whoever writes the time in their time zone too, Choose friction.
